text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e s-c-r-i-p-t to i-m-p-e-r-s-o-n-a-t-e a b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-r-m-i-n-a-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p l-o-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-n-e-d a f-a-c-i-a-l p-r-o-f-i-l-e from a s-t-o-l-e-n c-a-c-h-e, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-n-t-r-y, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l k-e-y-f-obe i-n-t-o the a-c-c-e-s-s p-a-n-e-l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-o-o-l m-a-r-k on the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d the l-o-g g-e-n-e-r-a-t-o-r to w-r-i-t-e a-l-t-e-r-n-a-t-e u-s-e-r i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t e-d b-l-o-c-k, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d the s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-a-c-h-e to h-i-d-e t-r-a-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-r-o-c-e-s h-a-n-d-l-e r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-e-m-o-r-y f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c s-c-a-n.
